== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Restraining Bolt (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Restraining Bolt]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100708 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100708], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100708-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>0069490b9d831ca4347448969c421ef287f020427d7acac656cc8db646887449</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
